+Check that RepoMetadata and Footprint.embedder(weightBytes:) size a CoreML repo (.mlpackage or .mlmodelc files) correctly. Fix them if they do not. Decide how joint fit counts an ANE model against the memory budget. Add unit tests with stub repo metadata. Context: the default embedding model will be erjigit17/embeddinggemma-300m-ane-coreml. This task does not depend on the Extras API.
+
+## Review Findings (2026-11-01 07:37)
+
+> Scope: `review sha 9def1244~1..9def1244` — reviewed the diffs only — lines this change added or modified. 5 file(s) reviewed, 0 not reviewed.
+
+- [ ] `Sources/FoundationModelsRouter/Sizing/RepoMetadata.swift:124` `swift/error-handling` — The tree listing is decoded with `try?` and a `?? []` fallback. A malformed listing is turned into an empty list without an error. The caller cannot learn that the listing was bad. The later guard then reports the wrong cause, "no *.safetensors weight files or Core ML bundles", for what is really a decode failure. Decode with `try` so that a bad listing throws. Map the error to `RepoMetadataError.metadataUnavailable` with a message that names the decode failure, for example `let entries = try decodeTreeEntries(raw.treeJSON, repo: repo)`. The weight-file error then means only that the listing decoded and held no weights.
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsRouterTests/RepoMetadataTests.swift:897` `test-integrity/no-test-cheating` — The test repoWithNoWeightsIsAnError asserts only that some RepoMetadataError is thrown. For this input (configJSON: nil, no weight files), the config.json guard in RepoMetadata.init(raw:repo:) runs before the new no-weights guard, so the test passes because config.json is missing, not because the tree has no weights. The test does not prove the behaviour its name claims, so it can pass when the new check is broken. Pass a valid config.json (for example Self.fullConfigJSON) so the config guard passes, and assert the specific message, such as `metadataUnavailable("no *.safetensors weight files or Core ML bundles in the repo tree")`. Then the test fails if the weight check is removed.
